examples.prompt: Please tell me a story with Tim in it.
examples.reply:
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a toy car that he loved to play with. One day, Tim's toy car broke. He was very sad.
Tim's mom saw him crying and asked, "Why are you sad, Tim?" Tim showed her the broken toy car. His mom said, "Don't worry, we can fix it."
Tim's mom took him to the store to buy a new toy car. Tim was very happy. He played with his new toy car all day long. And they all lived happily ever after.

examples.reply:
